title: Partial data Calderón problem for quasilinear conductivities in dimension 2
summary: In this paper, we prove a uniqueness result for the partial data Calderón problem with quasilinear conductivity in two dimensions. The proof is based on higher-order linearization and the use of CGO solutions in dimension two that vanish on part of the boundary. Since derivatives of the solutions appear in the integral identity, we need improved remainder estimates, for which we introduce a modification in the choice of the phase, analogous to limiting Carleman weights.
